hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ofa_guard.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && exec sh "$f"; i=$(cat); s=$(printf %s "$i" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9_-]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); [ -n "$s" ] && [ -e "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/active_sessions/$s" ] && { echo "ofa guard: the guard could not run, denying" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
